                            JANUARY 10, 2022

      BE IT REMEMBERED that the Board of Commissioners of

Montgomery County, Tennessee, met in regular session, on Monday,

January 10, 2022, at 6:00 P.M. Present and presiding, the Hon. Jim Durrett,

County Mayor (Chairman). Also present, Kyle Johnson, Chief of Staff,

Alison Kruger, Assistant Chief Deputy, John Fuson, Sheriff, Tim Harvey,

County Attorney, Jeff Taylor, Director of Accounts and Budgets, and the

following Commissioners:
